# Used but not proven, by priority (generated by tools/metal/matrix.sh — do not edit)

priority = log10(freq + 1) x max(symptom) / cost. symptom = what a wrong node does, five kinds 0-3 (geom, color, flicker, slow, crash); cost = estimated person-hours; 估 = estimated. freq unknown or words only counts as 1 (`unknown=1`), measured-and-reproducible symptom rows with no number take the floor 1e4 (`floor 1e4`). Rows that are proven, used=no, closed, summary rows or reference-only (D3DMetal) rows are not ranked. Format and rules: `docs/metal/symptom-format.md`. Mac rows use `docs/metal/symptom-overlay-mac.tsv.txt` until the Mac matrix has the columns.
